# UPchieve Changelog, week of Oct 10 to Oct 17, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Oct 15, subway Oct 15. These deploys carried the API contracts, Pinia stores, form components, coach opt-in, and logger work that last week's digest had as merged, approved, or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- **Send coaches' tutored session count to PostHog, so the application flag can target it:** 🚀 a `sessionsAsTutor` person property for coaches, the number of sessions they coached with time tutored, set from subway and left off for anyone without a coach role ([subway !3027](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3027)); 👀 the same property sent from the client too, so flag reloads after identify keep it ([high-line !1985](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1985)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🎁 **Credit the member who shared an NTHS invite link with the referral.** Chapter invite links only identified the chapter, so a volunteer who joined through one didn't count toward the inviter's referrals, and signing up with Google dropped the referral too. Copied invite links carry the member's referral code now, it survives the move from Join Team into volunteer sign-up, and Sign Up with Google sends it along. 🐛 [#737](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/737) ([high-line !2007](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2007)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🎁 **Let the chapter checklist change without a deploy, and keep each chapter's progress on it:** the checklist's sections, items, and resources load from a Google Sheet, validated and cached, with the last good copy served if a refresh fails ([subway !3059](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3059)); each chapter's progress on each item, as incomplete, completed, or skipped, with who changed it last and when, read and set through `/nths-groups/:groupId/checklist` ([subway !3060](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3060), [subway !3061](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3061)); progress a chapter made through the old NTHS actions carried over as completed, without overwriting anything already recorded ([subway !3064](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3064)). *Kasozi Wilson*

## My Coaches

Making the connections our power users make available to all users, earlier on. It runs through knowing your tutor, favorite coach presence, DMing a coach from one place instead of Session History, and in time things like asking for a specific coach.

- **Let a coach choose what a student sees about them.** The opt-in was an experiment; this makes it a feature. 🧪 the subway query that reads and writes the fields a coach picks ([subway !2939](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2939)); 🧪 high-line getting and storing the choice through it instead of passing the information over sockets ([high-line !1901](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1901)); 🧪 a tutor info card shown to students and previewed by coaches ([high-line !1902](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1902)); 🧪 the card on the student session view, collapsed to start so opening it can be counted ([high-line !1903](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1903)); 🧪 the dashboard modal redesigned and shown once, with clicking outside it storing an empty array, and coaches who saw it during the experiment seeing it again ([high-line !1904](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1904)); 🧪 the card added to background info in Edit Profile, where a coach can change their answer ([high-line !1905](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1905)); 👀 tests on both sides ([subway !2944](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2944), [high-line !1911](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1911)). Rolled out to no one yet ([`show-volunteer-opt-in-to-share-info`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/823424)). *Liseidy Bueno*

## API response contracts

A typed, tested contract for every API route's response.

- 🚀 **Contracts and mappers for fifteen more domains:** sessions, which also moves everything in `server/public/` to `server/contracts/` ([subway !3011](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3011)); stats ([subway !3012](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3012)); students ([subway !3013](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3013)); subjects ([subway !3014](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3014)); surveys ([subway !3015](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3015)); teachers ([subway !3016](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3016)); training ([subway !3020](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3020)); tutor bot ([subway !3031](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3031)); users, legacy user responses, and admin user responses ([subway !3032](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3032), [subway !3033](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3033), [subway !3037](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3037)); volunteers ([subway !3038](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3038)); auth routes ([subway !3039](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3039)); api-public routes ([subway !3040](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3040), [subway !3043](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3043)); contact routes ([subway !3041](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3041)); eligibility routes ([subway !3042](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3042)); analytics ([subway !3044](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3044)). *Trey Stevens*
- **Share subway's session contracts with high-line as a package:** 🚀 the session, survey, notification, and user-agent contracts moved into `@upchieve/api-contracts`, a package subway's pipeline publishes, so high-line can use subway's response types directly instead of keeping copies that can drift, with the mappers kept in subway ([subway !3050](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3050)); 🚀 the package publishes only when its source changes, and the job fails if that version is already published ([subway !3051](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3051)); ✅ high-line's session and survey requests converted to TypeScript on the package's types ([high-line !1994](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1994)). *Kasozi Wilson*

## End-to-end test suite

A browser test suite that drives high-line against a real subway, plus the work to make it run in CI.

- 🎁 **Stop dropping chat messages sent right after typing.** Pressing Enter right after typing into an empty chat box did nothing until TipTap caught up two animation frames later, which also made the chat e2e tests flaky. The send check reads the editor's text directly now, and the e2e `hasMessage` helper only matches sent messages. ([high-line !1990](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1990)) *Ben Wheeler*
- ✅ **Give urgent hotfixes a way past the tests.** Setting `TEST_DISABLED` on a fresh pipeline in GitLab skips the tests, and the test job becomes optional so it can be cancelled; cancelling it alone still doesn't let the MR merge. A trial run showed that skipping the tests on its own left the deploy jobs blocked, since they wait on the test job ([subway !3022](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3022)). ([subway !3029](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3029)) *Jamie Kasulis*

## Pinia migration

Moving high-line's state management from Vuex to Pinia.

- 🚀 **Seven more stores:** banner ([high-line !1978](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1978)); sidebar ([high-line !1979](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1979)); celebrations ([high-line !1980](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1980)); product flags ([high-line !1991](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1991)); notifications ([high-line !1981](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1981)); modal ([high-line !1992](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1992)); session ([high-line !2000](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2000)). *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Type Pinia setup stores correctly in the unit test type-check.** The test tsconfig had no DOM lib, so one `window.mathVirtualKeyboard` assignment in a spec stopped TypeScript from unwrapping refs, and setup store fields came out as `Ref<T>`. It inherits the app's lib now, which turned up six real typing errors in tests, fixed here, and cut the type-check errors roughly in half. ([high-line !2002](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2002)) *Ben Wheeler*

## Component library

Pulling high-line's presentation components out of the components that handle data, so non-engineers can change how the app looks without affecting how it works.

- 🚀 **Move the app's text, email, password, and checkbox inputs onto the form components:** text inputs replaced with `FormInput` ([high-line !1966](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1966)); `FormEmail` and `FormPassword` built on presentation components, with a `PasswordField` that owns the requirement wording, the checklist, and the show/hide eye ([high-line !1972](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1972)); email and password fields replaced with those, so every password field gets the show/hide eye and a requirements checklist in place of hint text, and the reset- and set-password pages show validation messages ([high-line !1974](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1974)); a presentation `CheckboxField` inside `FormCheckBox` ([high-line !1975](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1975)); the second checkbox component, `CheckBox`, replaced with `FormCheckBox` ([high-line !1989](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1989)); raw checkbox inputs replaced with `FormCheckBox`, which gains a green option for the presession survey ([high-line !1993](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1993)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Hand the presentation components to Iulia:** 🚀 Iulia is a code owner of `src/components/PresentationComponents/` and the six SCSS token files ([high-line !1995](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1995)); 👀 stylelint on that folder only, so colors, spacing, radius, fonts, and transitions there must use a variable or mixin from `src/scss/setup`, checked on pre-commit and in CI ([high-line !1998](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1998)). *Chris*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Give students a way past Clever Instant Login failures on school iPads:** the Clever sign-in error page has a Sign in with Clever button, which goes through the regular Clever flow that kept working ([high-line !2005](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2005)); failed SSO callbacks log whether our session cookie came back and what state the session was in, and `/auth/sso` logs when another sign-in was already in progress, to tell two sign-ins racing apart from a dropped cookie ([subway !3062](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3062)). *Ben Wheeler*
- **Close holes in SSO sign-in:** 🚀 a sign-in redirect path has to start with a single `/`, or it falls back to `/` (or `/login` after a failed login), since a value like `@example.com` would have become the host ([subway !3045](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3045)); 👀 the sign-up SSO buttons send only the fields subway reads, instead of every form field, which put the password in the URL and in subway's session ([high-line !1999](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1999)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Moderate image uploads against their own thresholds.** Image moderation reads the `image_upload` settings added last week instead of the real-time ones, so uploads can be tuned separately from screen sharing and audio. ([subway !3055](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3055)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Keep secrets and personal details out of subway's logs.** Query strings come off logged URLs and referers. Cookies, the authorization, API-key, load-test-key, CSRF, Twilio-signature, and reCAPTCHA headers, and `set-cookie` on responses are all removed. The request and config objects on logged errors are dropped, and phone numbers in the text-message log are masked. ([subway !3035](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3035)) *Alex Lindsay*
- **Give subway's logger one typed signature:** 🚀 `logger.*` takes the message first and an optional context second, typed instead of `any`, so log lines come out in one consistent shape, across 108 files ([subway !3034](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3034)); 👀 `logError` removed in favor of `logger.error` ([subway !3036](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3036)); 👀 `/server/worker/logger` folded into `/server/logger` ([subway !3047](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3047)); 👀 ESLint added to subway with one rule on, `use-unknown-in-catch-callback-variable`, so `tsc` catches `.catch()` callbacks still logging in the old argument order ([subway !3046](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3046)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Move the `Jobs` enum out of the worker job registry.** Services imported it from `worker/jobs/index.ts`, which loads every job and one-off script, so 109 server files sat in one import cycle (38 now) and tests loaded job modules they never use. The backend suite runs about 10 to 15% faster locally. ([subway !3052](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3052)) *Ben Wheeler*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Reset the chat's unread pill for each session, and drop its broken scroll restore:** a coach's unread messages pill carried into their next session, where it couldn't be clicked or cleared, and it now resets whenever the chat shows a different session, live or on a recap 🐛 [#742](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/742) ([high-line !2001](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2001)); the chat tried to reopen at its last scroll position, but since June 2025 that code ran before the chat rendered, so it threw and the chat opened at the bottom anyway, and now it's gone ([high-line !2003](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2003)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Let a session recap's document editor scroll again.** Once a student had been in a live session, a recap's document editor had no scrollbar, so they couldn't scroll down to read what they wrote. A global Quill style meant for the live editor was leaking onto recaps; it only applies to live editors now. 🐛 [#734](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/734) ([high-line !2006](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2006)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🎁 **Send a signed-out user to `/login` from anywhere.** The API's 401 redirect was a relative path, so from a session page it could go to `/session/math/algebra-one/login`, which treated `login` as the session id and failed with a 500. ([high-line !1988](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1988)) *Trey Stevens*
- ✅ **Manage PhotoDNA's quarantine storage in Pulumi, and add private storage for its SDK.** The storage that holds the uploads PhotoDNA matched, and the grants that let subway write to it and reviewers read it, are in Pulumi now, protected so Pulumi can never delete them. Staging and production each get a private `photodna-sdk` container for Microsoft's licensed edge hash library, for subway to download at runtime, since it can't be shared publicly. Part of 🐛 [#741](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/741), where an image upload got stuck loading. ([GCS !198](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/grand-central-station/-/merge_requests/198)) *Chris*
- 👀 **Let a student whose email isn't verified sign in with SSO.** Seven students in one class, joining their teacher's class through ClassLink, landed back on the login page with "Your classlink account is not associated with this account," because each had an email-and-password account whose email wasn't verified. SSO sign-in takes over the unverified account now and verifies it. 🐛 [#748](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/748) ([subway !3057](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3057)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 👀 **Throw when a repository write matches no row.** Twenty write checks in `server/models` could never fire, so an update that matched no row passed silently. Every write check goes through `ensureWriteOk` in `pgUtils` now, and a session report with an unknown reason gets a 422 before anything is written. ([subway !3056](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3056)) *Ben Wheeler*
